clues: This town is the sole town of its province, and it fills a whole isle. It sits mid-way on the shore of a great isle's north.
Rain falls hard here all year round. There is no dry time in this town's year at all.
This isle was rich in oil in the days of Dutch rule. In the great war it was one of the first marks the foe struck.
This town's bounds are the isle's own bounds. Two small isles off its shore are thrown in as well.
By the mid of 2024, the folk count of this town stood at more than a quarter of a million souls.
